name: vip-mobiles
description: VIP Mobiles - Mobile Store E-commerce & Management Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run generate --workspace=packages/db
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run start --workspace=apps/api" "npm run start --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/db && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
